objective: Close the loop from Skill/Attribute growth readiness back to the exact active Quest already mapped to that growth target, without creating new quests, changing focus, or guessing among ambiguous candidates.

roles_before.artifact: Quest growth mappings already identify which active Quest contributes to which Skill/Attribute.
Player UI now explains unmet evidence gates but does not identify the active mapped Quest that can generate relevant evidence.
Exactly zero or one active Quest may be focused; focus is state truth and must not be changed by navigation.
PWA can switch views but has no Growth-target -> Quest deep-link path.
Neon/PostgreSQL remains sole mutable owner; navigation is projection-only.
Git history is sufficient; no state migration.

role_dispositions.destination: Use existing prospective mapping only; no new inferred mapping.
Readiness surfaces also expose a deterministic active mapped Quest when exactly one candidate exists or the candidate is already focused.
CTA navigation never writes quest.focus or any ledger event.
Add a client-side CTA that switches to the Quests view, opens the exact mapped Quest card, scrolls it into view, and preserves all state ownership.
No action API call or mutation.

capability_probes.assertion: German Language and INT can point to the already-focused active lesson-3 Quest from their Growth surfaces.
A single active background mapped Quest may be linked because no candidate choice is required.
Multiple non-focused active candidates fail closed with no arbitrary CTA.
Completed/cancelled/failed/expired mapped Quests never appear as active Growth CTAs.
Following a Growth CTA changes only the local PWA view/open card state; it does not call the System action endpoint or alter Quest focus.
XP/Coins, Growth evidence, Mastery, competency, attributes, streak, Challenge, achievements, shop, Boss/Arc/Rank and external-owner semantics remain unchanged.
No new event/action/schema or historical reinterpretation.

tests.expected: focused/unique candidates resolve and ambiguous/terminal candidates fail closed.
CTA renders and opens exact Quest card without action API mutation.
